propositions: Release 0.11.0 was successfully cut from main, published to PyPI, tagged on GitHub, and deployed to MCP Registry and Homebrew with all artifacts and provenance verifiable.

Documentation and acceptance criteria incorrectly prescribed `gh attestation verify` (GitHub Artifact Attestations / SLSA predicate) instead of `pypi-attestations verify` (PEP 740 publish/v1 bundle) for verifying PyPI-uploaded wheel provenance.
The published 0.11.0 wheel passes authoritative PyPI provenance verification and channel probe validation; no artifact quality or security issue detected.
Release process required amendment during CI to include uv.lock regeneration in lockstep with pyproject.toml version bump to 0.11.0.
Follow-up work (ticket 13b4-c597-200b-4e31) must correct docs/releasing.md runbook and workflow comments to use the correct PyPI verifier tooling.
